Hero_Desc_Rollett:
A former witch turned street magician wandering the Sprite Kingdom.
She seeks out entertaining sights and sometimes ensures that events end in an "interesting" way.
If she keeps bothering you, it might be because you've made a mistake you're unaware of.
Album_Like_Rollett: A fun spectacle like a circus.
Album_Hate_Rollett: A dull, ordinary life, lack of reactions.
Album_Wish_Rollett: Having everyone enjoy the show she puts on.
Album_Rollett1: While strolling through the streets of the Sprite Kingdom, I came across Rollett performing a mime act. At first, I thought she was a statue, but when I reached out to touch her, she suddenly moved, startling me.
Album_Rollett2: Rollett greeted me warmly and casually put an arm around my shoulder. Later, I discovered a note stuck to my back that said "Dork". I was slightly annoyed, but thanks to the note, I stopped just in time to avoid stepping into a puddle... was that really just a coincidence?
Album_Rollett3: I observed Rollett for a while and noticed that, besides mime and circus acts, she was always busy doing various things. She often helped others in mischievous ways, then enjoyed watching their reactions and the aftermath. That must be Rollett's true personality.
Album_Rollett4: While wandering the streets after sunset, I spotted Rollett finishing up a performance. She was wiping off her stage makeup, but when she realized I was watching, she seemed quite flustered and asked me to keep it a secret.
Album_Rollett5: Rollett said she left the mature witch society because it had lost all sense of fun. She called the Sprite Kingdom a place full of idiots with potential, brimming with possibilities for amusement... I think I get what she means. Maybe.
Album_Rollett6: When Rollett meets Gabia, they communicate through miming. At a glance, it looks like a mystical, silent performance between two people exchanging unspoken words, but in reality... Gabia just has a naturally quiet voice. If you look closely, Gabia actually seems quite frustrated and bewildered.
Album_Rollett7: Rollett says she has high expectations for my potential. She claims that my sudden arrival and influence over Elias makes me the key to shaping its future, and she looks forward to seeing what I'll do next.

Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Hate1: Despite its fancy decoration, Rollett grumbled that it's just a fruit skewer. In her words, it's like the food from the Witch Kingdom.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Hate2: Rollett said that if she's going to drink this, might as well drink regular grape juice. She also noted that everyone makes the same, easy choice when they drink it, and she gave it a low score.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like1: Rollett was intrigued by the stimulating flavor despite its seemingly ordinary appearance. In her words, it's exactly the food from the Sprite Kingdom.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like2: Rollett sprinkled the familiar dressing and bit into it gracefully. With her genteel manner, she praised the banquet hall without reservation.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like3: Rollett felt the texture was a bit odd but complimented it as a rather savory and delicious soup.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like4: Rollett ate it with elegance and tidiness. Repeatedly she asked for agreement, commenting that the design of the Bûche de Noël was quite absurd.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like5: Rollett sneezed into the powder several times. Just when she was getting annoyed, she realized it had been switched with YumYum Vita-C. If only someone had told her...
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like6: Rollett seemed to appreciate the Songpyeon made with ingredients that suited a witches' taste. Then, a little anxiously, asked to pack some.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like7: Rollett laughed, saying it was unexpected to receive such food from the Master. When told it was handmade, she praised its outstanding taste.
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like8: Rollett spilled water over it several times, melting it all. Just as she was getting annoyed, she realized it had been switched with Sour Vita F. If only someone had told her...
Food_ChefNote_Rollett_Like9: Interestingly, Rollett first showed interest in sprite-themed candy. Does Rollett genuinely find the Sprite Kingdom more intriguing than the Witch Kingdom?

LoveLetter_Rollett:
Bonjour!

A considerable time has passed since I came to the Sprite Kingdom. Thank you for helping me adapt to life here throughout that time. Without your help, I would surely have found it difficult. I am truly grateful. With that in mind, how about tea?

I prepared tea and refreshments that I believe will suit your tastes. I hope you visit before the fragrance of the tea leaves fades.
LoveCall_Rollett:
Master, are you having a bonbon day?
I am on my way home after finishing today's show.
It is always bittersweet to bring a performance to an end, whether one created the stage or watched from the audience.

So I have been thinking. I want to remain a part of the show you create forever.
Standing beside you and watching the stories in which you take part, unfolding around you, always fills me with joy.
Of course, nothing could be finer than sharing the stage with you.
I too will always work to make our endlessly delightful show a reality.

Though our call lasted only a moment, I hope it remains a happy experience for you. I shall end it here.
Merci, mon pote.
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_001: Master, I would like you to recommend the most luxurious dish in the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_002: Even if it is the most expensive one?
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_003: Being afraid of the price in one's pursuit of fine cuisine makes no sense. Hehe.
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_004: Our restaurant is famous for its water.
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_005: I heard that means 'this restaurant's food is terrible' in some places. Are you sure about this?
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_006: You just ate an entire plate.
Affinity_Rollett_EP01_007: Hors d'oeuvre, main course, dessert! Let us follow the proper structure of a full-course meal.
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_001: Watching something grow is a wonderful spectacle. I enjoy it immensely.
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_002: There are some who do not seem to be growing at all.
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_003: I am not speaking only of visible growth. A sprout can grow inside its seed.
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_004: Do you believe anyone can grow?
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_005: You must observe them over a long span of time. Is living not ultimately a form of growth?
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_006: What do you mean by growth? Upward? Sideways?
Affinity_Rollett_EP02_007: Hmm, neither is easy in Elias, even though everyone eats so much.
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_001: Do you have anything that is soft and slightly bitter, yet sweet at the same time?
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_002: You need to eat hard things too if you want strong teeth.
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_003: I will have you know my teeth are quite healthy. Still, thank you for worrying about them.
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_004: Then put several things in your mouth and chew them together.
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_005: Hmmm. Crushing the spectrum of flavors together like that is not a proper attitude for a chef.
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_006: If such a thing existed, do you think I would be working as the chef?
Affinity_Rollett_EP03_007: Is that so? Should the Master of the Yggdrasil Order not possess at least that much?
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_001: Witches understand fine cuisine too. We do not simply eat anything and everything.
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_002: That is unexpected. I thought you preferred health food.
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_003: Finding beauty of flavor even within healthy food is gastronomy. The two are not so different.
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_004: Looking at your queen, I suppose that might be true.
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_005: You even know Her Majesty's preferences? The Banquet Hall is a surprisingly intimate place.
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_006: That does not mean the other races understand fine cuisine.
Affinity_Rollett_EP04_007: Hmm-hmm. Eating for pleasure rather than merely out of necessity means one has an aptitude for gastronomy.
Affinity_Rollett_EP05_001: Master Couturier's tailor shop is a fine boutique. Have you ever visited, Master?
Affinity_Rollett_EP05_003: Cou-tu-ri-er. Is it difficult to understand? Would it be easier if I simply said Chloe?
Affinity_Rollett_EP05_004: That tailor shop actually belongs to Sebastian.
Affinity_Rollett_EP05_005: Aha, Sebastian. Chloe's beautiful companion. It seems you know him well too, Master.
Affinity_Rollett_EP05_006: Chloe is fortunate to have a friend like you.
Affinity_Rollett_EP05_007: Is it not natural to praise one's friend? You speak as though you have no friends, Master.
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_001: There is a saying that the more foolish someone is, the stronger they are. What do you think, Master?
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_002: It seems true to some extent.
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_003: The relationship between intellect and strength! I am delighted that the Master shares my view.
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_004: Everyone here is stronger than I am.
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_005: Oh dear. I would not ordinarily recommend the witches' training methods, but you appear to need them, Master.
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_006: Intelligent people simply do not boast about their strength.
Affinity_Rollett_EP06_007: Tres bien! Strength and wisdom can coexist, but the wise have no need to resort to strength.
Affinity_Rollett_EP07_001: What kind of act would you like to see at the circus, Master?
Affinity_Rollett_EP07_002: Something that flies through the sky.
Affinity_Rollett_EP07_003: That is not difficult. Even if your body cannot fly, it is easy to experience the feeling of flight.
Affinity_Rollett_EP07_005: Balancing atop a ball is rather conventional, is it not? It is a little dull.
Affinity_Rollett_EP07_007: It seems you enjoy spectacle, Master. Now then, may I use the kitchen for a moment?
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_001: A napkin, please. Preferably one adorned with elegant embroidery.
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_002: Hand her a napkin embroidered with flowers.
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_003: This resembles my friend's handiwork. Is this your idea of elegance, Master?
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_004: Hand her a napkin embroidered with a teddy bear.
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_005: Elegance can be interpreted in many ways. Cuteness can be elegant too.
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_006: Subtly hand her the cloth used to wipe the table.
Affinity_Rollett_EP08_007: Sacre bleu! What are you doing? You would give me this and call it a napkin?
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_001: A circus ringmaster needs excellent stamina. We must constantly face the fiercest of opponents.
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_002: Do you raise wild beasts or something?
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_003: Beastly opponents can be found everywhere, but I was merely speaking metaphorically...
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_004: Difficult customers are no joke, are they?
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_005: Ah, there are always those who watch my show and feel they did not get their money's worth. What must such people see to be moved?
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_006: Is there some hidden meaning here? Are you talking about money?
Affinity_Rollett_EP09_007: Hmm. You have keenly identified the practical problem. Once the show ends, the real battle begins.
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_001: What do you think is the difference between a bard and a clown, Master?
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_002: One sings and the other dances?
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_003: That is far too simplistic! One who sings can dance, and one who dances can sing!
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_004: I do not think there is much difference.
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_005: Both make their audience laugh, cry, and feel deeply! Perhaps they are essentially the same.
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_006: If you do both, do you earn twice as much?
Affinity_Rollett_EP10_007: You sometimes say such materialistic things, Master. Though I find that side of you interesting too.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_001: Hmm. I ate well, but it was not enough. I shall order another melon bocconcini. At once.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_002: Do not behave like a difficult customer. It does not suit you.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_003: Do not become so angry. Think it through carefully, Master.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_004: You are trying to tell me we are out of cheese, correct? I know.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_005: You noticed already? As expected, you are not to be underestimated, Master.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_006: That works out nicely. We have plenty of melon bocconcini in stock, so eat it all before you leave.
Affinity_Rollett_EP11_007: My, my. This is another unexpected development.
Affinity_Rollett_EP12_001: My first meeting with the Sprite Queen was... quite memorable.
Affinity_Rollett_EP12_002: I will never forget my first encounter with her either.
